items.headline: MiniMax releases MiniMax M3
items.summary: MiniMax M3 is a natively multimodal model for coding and agents with up to 1M-token context via a new MiniMax Sparse Attention design, and image, video and computer-use input. MiniMax reports 59.0% on SWE-Bench Pro and said the weights and technical report would follow within about ten days.
